document.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content:
IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 3):2007
SAFETY OF HOUSEHOLD AND SIMILAR ELECTRICAL APPLIANCES
PART 2: PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS - SECTION 3: ELECTRIC IRONS
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 1.1 This standard deals with the safety of electric dry irons and steam irons, including those with a separate water reservoir or boiler having a capacity not exceeding 5 litres, for household and similar purposes.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 1.2 The rated voltage is not more than 250 V for single-phase appliances and 480 V for other appliances.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 1.3 Appliances not intended for normal household use, but which nevertheless may be a source of danger to the public, such as appliances intended to be used by laymen in shops, in light industry and on farms, are within the scope of this standard.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 3.1 Steam Iron - An electric iron having means for producing and supplying steam to the textile while ironing.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 3.2 Cordless Iron - An iron that is placed on a base during heating and removed from the base during ironing.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 4.1 Appliances shall be constructed so that in normal use they function safely so as to cause no danger to persons or surroundings, even in the event of careless operation.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 8.1 Appliances shall be constructed and enclosed so that there is adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons
chunks.section_title: 8. PROTECTION AGAINST ACCESS TO LIVE PARTS

chunks.content: 8.2 Openings in live parts shall be designed so that testing finger probes conforming to IS 1401 cannot touch live electrical conductors.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons
chunks.section_title: 8. PROTECTION AGAINST ACCESS TO LIVE PARTS

chunks.content: 11.1 Appliances and their surroundings shall not attain excessive temperature in normal use.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons

chunks.content: 11.2 For electric irons, the soleplate temperature shall be controlled by a reliable thermostat conforming to IS 302-1.
chunks.document_title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Particular Requirements: Electric Irons
